note: Everyday sentences to say aloud in the Trommelhaus at Oberstufe (A2): first drafts for the parents to check.

sentences.text: A return ticket to Bern, please.
Which platform does the train leave from?
sentences.de: Von welchem Gleis fährt der Zug?

sentences.text: Sorry, the bus is late.
We went to the sea last summer.
sentences.de: Letzten Sommer gingen wir ans Meer.

sentences.text: Here is my passport.
I have a lot of homework today.
Can you repeat that, please?
My favourite subject is maths.
We have an English test on Friday.
sentences.de: Wir haben am Freitag einen Englischtest.

sentences.text: I don't understand the question.
I have one brother and one sister.
sentences.de: Ich habe einen Bruder und eine Schwester.

sentences.text: My mum is forty-two years old.
sentences.de: Meine Mutter ist zweiundvierzig Jahre alt.

sentences.text: My grandparents live in Lucerne.
We have a dog called Max.
sentences.de: Wir haben einen Hund namens Max.

sentences.text: We often eat dinner together.
sentences.de: Wir essen oft zusammen zu Abend.

sentences.text: I play football on Wednesdays.
What kind of music do you like?
Shall we go to the cinema tonight?
sentences.de: Gehen wir heute Abend ins Kino?

sentences.text: What did you do at the weekend?
sentences.de: Was hast du am Wochenende gemacht?

sentences.text: I'm learning to play the guitar.
I'm really hungry.
I'd like a pizza, please.
sentences.de: Ich hätte gern eine Pizza, bitte.

sentences.text: Can we have the bill, please?
I have bread and jam for breakfast.
sentences.de: Zum Frühstück esse ich Brot mit Konfitüre.

sentences.text: I don't like vegetables very much.
sentences.de: Ich mag Gemüse nicht so gern.

sentences.text: My aunt works as a doctor.
What do you want to be later?
I'm looking for an apprenticeship.
My dad works in an office.
sentences.de: Mein Vater arbeitet in einem Büro.

sentences.text: I want to earn my own money.
sentences.de: Ich will mein eigenes Geld verdienen.

sentences.text: I have a headache.
I don't feel well today.
sentences.de: Ich fühle mich heute nicht gut.

sentences.text: He broke his arm skiing.
sentences.de: Er hat sich beim Skifahren den Arm gebrochen.

sentences.text: You should sleep more.
I have to go to the dentist.
My room is small but cosy.
sentences.de: Mein Zimmer ist klein, aber gemütlich.

sentences.text: We live in a flat in town.
sentences.de: Wir wohnen in einer Wohnung in der Stadt.

sentences.text: I have to tidy my room.
The kitchen is next to the living room.
sentences.de: Die Küche ist neben dem Wohnzimmer.

sentences.text: We have a big garden.
Excuse me, where is the station?
Go straight on and turn left.
Is it far from here?
The museum is opposite the bank.
sentences.de: Das Museum ist gegenüber der Bank.

sentences.text: I think we're lost.
sentences.de: Ich glaube, wir haben uns verirrt.

sentences.text: It's raining again.
It will be sunny tomorrow.
It's very cold this morning.
sentences.de: Heute Morgen ist es sehr kalt.

sentences.text: We went hiking in the mountains.
sentences.de: Wir waren in den Bergen wandern.

sentences.text: I love the snow in winter.
sentences.de: Ich liebe den Schnee im Winter.

sentences.text: How much does this cost?
Do you have this in a bigger size?
sentences.de: Haben Sie das eine Nummer grösser?

sentences.text: I'm just looking, thank you.
Can I pay by card?
These shoes are too expensive.
How are you today?
I'm a bit tired.
I'm happy to see you.
sentences.de: Ich freue mich, dich zu sehen.

sentences.text: Don't worry, it's fine.
I'm nervous about the exam.
sentences.de: Ich bin nervös wegen der Prüfung.
